activity: {action, select, team_created {{actor} made the team} team_renamed {{actor} renamed the team} member_invited {{actor} invited someone} member_joined {{actor} joined} member_declined {{actor} declined an invitation} member_invite_cancelled {{actor} withdrew an invitation} member_invite_expired {An invitation ran out} member_role_changed {{actor} changed the role of {subject}} member_removed {{actor} removed {subject}} member_left {{actor} left} member_account_closed {{subject} left when their account closed} team_frozen {The team was paused} payout_account_added {{actor} added a payout account} payout_account_removed {{actor} removed a payout account} payout_account_default {{actor} changed the main payout account} payout_requested {{actor} asked for a payout} event_cancelled {{actor} cancelled an event} promotion_bought {{actor} paid to feature an event or a place} content_published {{actor} posted to Spotlight or Stories} team_converted {{actor} made their organizer account this team} other {{actor} made a change}}
checkInBody: Scan or type the code under a guest's QR. Only this event's tickets are accepted.
comingSoon: Run the team's events, places, money, messages, reviews, Spotlights and Stories by choosing the team under "Managing as". Paying to promote a Spotlight as a team is coming soon.
createBody: A team has its own name and @username. You'll be its first Owner and can then invite the others.
idCheckNote: Owners and Finance need the ID check before the team can be paid.
intro: Run an organizer or a place together. Everyone signs in with their own account and has a role that covers only what they need.
inviteBody: They join when they accept. Choose the role that covers only what they need.
lastOwnerHint: You're the only Owner. Make another member an Owner before you leave.
laterAsTeam: Paying to promote a Spotlight as a team is coming soon.
leaveConfirmBody: You'll lose access to the team. An Owner can invite you again.
listingIsYours: This is your own listing, and you're managing as a team right now.
noTeams: You're not in any team yet.
notMember: You're not a member of this team.
notTexted: We couldn't text this number. Tell them to sign up on Abonten with it to accept.
pausedLong: This team is paused: nobody can act for it until it has an Owner again. Abonten support can help.
phoneHint: If this number has no Abonten account yet, we'll text it a link. They sign up with the number to accept.
removeConfirmBody: Their access to the team ends at once. Their own account isn't affected.
role: {role, select, owner {Owner} finance {Finance} manager {Manager} content {Content and messages} door {Door staff} front_desk {Front desk} other {Member}}
roleDoesNotCover: Your role in this team doesn't cover this. Switch to your own account to see yours.
roleHelp: {role, select, owner {Everything, including members and the payout account.} finance {Payouts, refunds, featuring and money reports.} manager {Events, the place page, promo codes and bookings.} content {Spotlight, Stories, messages and replies to reviews.} door {Scanning tickets at the door, nothing else.} front_desk {Booking requests and the visit QR.} other {}}
teamPayoutAccountRules: Changing the team's payout account needs a recent sign-in, and every Owner is told. Payouts can go to a new account 48 hours after it was added.
title: Teams
usernameHint: Letters, numbers and underscores, 3 to 30 characters.
convertTitle: Make your organizer account a team
convertBody: Your events and places, their reviews and followers, the conversations about them, your organizer money and payout accounts, and your Verified badges move to a new team that keeps your @username, name and photo. You become its first Owner and get a new @username. Your tickets, credit, Spotlights, Stories and direct messages stay with you.
convertConfirm: @{handle} will belong to the team, and you will get a new @username. This can't be undone in the app.
convertedToast: Done. {team} now runs your events and places. Your new @username is @{username}.
renameVerifiedBody: The Verified badge names the business, so it comes off and goes back to review until Abonten checks the new name. Abonten may ask for papers in the new name.
convertedBadgeInReview: Your Verified badge moved to the team and is back in review: Abonten checks the team as a business before it shows again.
